verdict.rationale: Docs show real controls: admins/engineers can add/remove MCP servers, inspect available tools before use, and configure approval modes for file edits/command execution (codex-docs-16, codex-docs-17, codex-docs-20, codex-docs-22). However, community reports raise concerns about sandboxing effectiveness and unauthorized file access, suggesting these controls aren't always trusted or fully enforced in practice.
